1.consolidated_definition: Variedad de gallo que se caracteriza por la rabadilla deforme con largas y finas plumas hacia abajo que semejan la cola de una langosta. El informante de Coamo añade que las pocas plumas en el rabo del gallo chimbolo inclinadas hacia abajo se deben a que el padre o la madre eran bolos. Chimbolo es derivado puertorriqueño de chingo, animal de poco rabo, chato, romo en Venezuela y América Central. Originalmente debió ser chingolo, pero por etimología popular, al asociarse con bolo surgió chimbolo. Al chimbolo se le conoce también en Puerto Rico como gallo langosta.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Variety of rooster characterized by a deformed rump with long and fine feathers pointing downwards resembling the tail of a lobster. The informant from Coamo adds that the few feathers on the tail of the chimbolo rooster pointed downwards are due to the fact that the father or mother were bolos. Chimbolo is a Puerto Rican derivation of chingo, an animal with little tail, short and blunt in Venezuela and Central America. Originally it should have been chingolo, but through popular etymology, when associated with bolo, it emerged as chimbolo. The chimbolo is also known in Puerto Rico as lobster rooster.
